featured_reviews.review_text:
Bimbo, Bristol Bakery in Mahim is a true gem for anyone who appreciates high-quality baked goods. The bakery offers a delightful array of fresh breads, pastries, and cakes that are both delicious and beautifully presented.
Highly recommended for anyone who loves great bakery products and a pleasant shopping experience!

featured_reviews.name: Ravinarayan P.S.
featured_reviews.review_text:
Looking for Bakery products.... If you have reached here... ie BIMBO Bakery at Mahim....means you have arrived at the perfect place.

No better place to pick you choice of Breads & as their tagline suggests... "If it's fresher than Bimbo, it's still in the Oven".

Range of toasts and kharis to appease your taste buds, the sister shop JimmyBoy bakes wonderful cakes pastries and what not.

We just keep coming... Just yesterday picked up a dozen ladis of pav for Pav Bhaji...it's simply too good & you can eat pav just like it.

Thanks BIMBO.

featured_reviews.name: Farhan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jimmy Boy Bakery in Mahim is a classic spot for freshly baked snacks and savouries that never disappoint. Located next to Bhagat Tarachand, this place is perfect if you’re craving quick veg and non-veg bites without burning a hole in your pocket. The bakery offers simple, comforting food that’s great for takeaway or a quick snack break.

From patties to puffs and other baked goodies, Jimmy Boy Bakery Mahim stands out for its consistent taste and affordable pricing. If you’re looking for one of the best bakeries in Mahim for snacks, this is a must-visit. Ideal for locals, office-goers, and anyone exploring Mahim food spots.

featured_reviews.name: Samruddhi Naik
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're looking for delicious snacks in Mahim, look no further than Jimmy Boy Food! The flavors are absolutely top-notch, making every bite a delightful experience. Whether you're craving something savory or sweet, their menu has something to satisfy every palate.

The quality of the food is exceptional, and you can really taste the freshness in every dish. The ambiance is also cozy, perfect for enjoying a quick snack or hanging out with friends.

featured_reviews.name: Rizwan Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: My recent visit to Crystal Bakery left me deeply disappointed. The staff's arrogance and lack of customer service skills were evident from the start. They don't accept Google Pay, relying solely on cash, which is inconvenient in this day and age. The owner's demeanor was particularly appalling; he made customers feel unwelcome and undervalued. It's alarming how simple interactions can leave one feeling like a burden. The owner's behavior borders on ruthlessness, fostering a hostile atmosphere. No customer should feel they're receiving a favor by making a purchase. I was compelled to file a police complaint due to this mistreatment. Crystal Bakery must address these issues urgently to regain trust. Until then, I can't recommend it.

featured_reviews.review_text:

The location is also noteworthy, situated near the Mahim Makhdum Shah Baba shrine, a landmark in its own right.

featured_reviews.name: Tarun S
featured_reviews.review_text: Came here for the Spain pop-up and we tried almost everything on the menu. I loved the Chorizo Puff, Jamon Iberico Flatbread and the Ice Cream Sandwich! Honourable mention for the Delhi Carrot Cake, the Lavender Madeleines, and the Saffron Custard Tarts.

featured_reviews.name: Mallika Fatehpuria
featured_reviews.review_text: Quite easily the best bakery in the city! No one does Bombay like they do! Right from their modern take on nostalgic desserts to the flakiest puff pastries you’ll ever eat - no body does it better than this team. Their weekend specials are something I look forward to and their menu regulars like the tiramisu, eclairs are my top picks! Highly, highly recommended trying everything they have!

featured_reviews.name: jyothi chandani
featured_reviews.review_text: Maska bakery is easily one of the top 3 bakeries in Mumbai, all of their stuff tastes incredible, got to taste the kairi tart today which was sheer brilliance. Also the mango tadgola litchi tres leches was so light and refreshing. They keep changing their menu every season and that's really cool. Have to say, what I really admired from my visit today was that they're a well trained team which speaks a lot about the owner. Every order was packed within the time slot, they are very organised and professional and hospitable. And stuff like this make me so happy that a place is trying to tick all the boxes not just the food. Also please try their black forest cake, it's not sweet but it's still incredible.

featured_reviews.name: Nirav Gangar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Heard about the bakery through a friend and visited the place to try out some of their items. We ordered for the below food items -
1. Khatta-Meetha mango kairi tart - It was delicious with the write amounts of sweet and savoury. It is a must order while the mango season is still going on.
2. Maska bourbon biscuit - All the childhood memories hit me as soon I took a bit into the bourbon biscuit. The only difference was it being in dark chocolate so it wasn’t that sweet.

Loved both the items and would visit again to try some more vegetarian options from their menu.
The place is more of a cloud kitchen & take away and less of a place to sit and enjoy. There is a table there which can for in 4/5 people so you can take your chances visiting.

All in all, it was a great experience visiting the place and having some mouth-watering tart.

featured_reviews.name: drkshaa
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wanted to visit Maska Bakery ever since I watched a reel of a baker from this place. The place felt so homely that I was longing to experience it in real.

Finally, on 10th August 2024, I visited the bakery with my friends. Locating it was a task, being not so known of the neighborhood. I was excited; however, my friends, who didn't even know this bakery's name were skeptical but gave a thumbs up for the visit. The place has a washroom for diners on the first floor of the building, do ask the staff.

It is located inside a building, on the ground floor. It is a small bakery. It's so beautiful and aromatic. There's only one large table and few chairs for dine-in experience. The table was occupied by people; however, they were kind enough to make place for me and my friends. One can view the process of baking and fresh products being prepared from their seat as there is a partition of glass where the baking happens.

It was a delightful evening for me to sit in that atmosphere and inhale the aromas of the products being prepared. We were greeted by a beautiful young lady, she was so sweet and precise with our requirements. We ordered quite a few delicacies (idr the names, sorry). All were YUM. I'm not a dessert person; however, I can have desserts from this place anytime. The perfect bakery experience.

We ordered 3 items and our bill was around 1500rs or 1200rs (idr, sorry). It's a moderately expensive place; however, for the ambience and service and especially the lip smacking desserts and snacks. It is worth every penny. Unfortunately, they don't serve drinks. I think they should consider adding Hot Chocolate to their menu, they would ace it. I like how this bakery is not very popular, otherwise it would be mainstream and flooded by content creators; however, I want them to grow and have a bigger place in future with the same partition thing. As I feel the small dine-in situation can burden them. With the bigger place, I would surely visit them more. If you're in Mahim or nearby. Visit this bakery to soak in the aroma or you may order the delectables at your place. Enjoy!

featured_reviews.name: Upjas sublok
featured_reviews.review_text: Croissant cake was out of the world, loved everything, the staff is very welcoming! The best desserts I have had.

featured_reviews.name: Pratibha Sonawane
featured_reviews.review_text:
Take a bow, team Maska!
Each item l sampled was a decadent treat for all the senses, be it the delicate lemon Bundt cake or the rich and sinful eclairs. The savory Kejriwal babka bread was really special too. I haven't experienced a flavor so comforting and nostalgic in a long while. Can't wait to try more of these goodies. Truly a memorable experience!

featured_reviews.name: Jyoti Vora
featured_reviews.review_text: Most finger licking deserts I have had. The right amount of sweetness in each and every bite. Chef Heena spins her magic and has a fantastic team to back her. A must try indeed in Bombay. Have ordered so many times for family and friends and its been a fab experience always. Even have carried the cookies to the US 🍪

featured_reviews.review_text:
Nostalgia at its best! This place hasn't changed & neither have the people running it. They serve the same items along with some add ons that are of good quality. Pricing is a little on the higher side but since the quality is maintained, it's worth it. The elderly gent still treats you like his child and takes interest in the items you buy. He will also serve you chutney and ketchup if you are going to eat at the premises. Hard to find such warmth in people these days!

Items worth buying are
Chicken seekh roll
Chicken Partice
Omelette Sandwiches
Cheese Chutney Sandwiches
Thalipeeth
Bread Rolls
Garlic Bread

For those living near Mahim, this bakery would be their best bet. I will definitely keep visiting if I am near the vicinity.
Recommended to visit at least once if not more !

featured_reviews.name: Rashmi Vaid
featured_reviews.review_text: Some things never change.... n they sud not. I have been going to Vijai Bakery from my childhood. Holding my dad's hand i have walked to the store many a times. Today i walked in with my son! Nearly 35 years and they still have maintained the best standards of whatever they serve. New dishes added to the menu and quality still maintained. I met the next generation behind the counter too.... and saw the same love and passion for the store. The Chicken Mayo roll is nostalgic.  Out of the world!  Hope they go online so that we can call for stuff frequently. I wish the very best to them.

featured_reviews.name: Vinayak Kori
featured_reviews.review_text: I showed monorail cake picture with strawberries at the edge to the staff at the Celejor Mahim. He said to me that strawberry season is over so they will make this cake with cherries. Staff also said that the monorail cake can only be made of at least 4 kg & will cost Rs. 7000. I agreed to all the conditions the staff told me of & ordered the monorail cake for my nephew's birthday. I requested this staff for discount but he refused. Then the staff made the bill of Rs. 7200. When I told him that the agreed price for cake is Rs. 7000 to which he said that I need to pay Rs. 7000 only but he has to show Rs. 7200 (discount of Rs. 200) to the company. The cake arrived on time. It's was tasty & picture perfect however had rose petals at the edges & not cherries. As I cannot return the cake on  birthday evening I accepted it but complaint about it after two days to Celejor Mahim. The staff at the counter was different who connected a call to the staff who took my order. The staff who took my order gave me all sorts of excuses for not having cherries in my ordered birthday cake & why they chose to put rose petals. I explained to the staff that only a single rose was used to cover all the edges of the birthday cake but they will require a box of cherries for the same. I informed him that I work for an international cruise company (hospitality industry) which also has bakery/pastry section on all the ships. I explained him the price difference between a single rose & a box of cherries & asked for discount accordingly. The staff then lied saying he has already given me Rs. 200 discount at the time of booking. I clearly told him that he is lying & demanded for Celejor's head office contact number. Since the staff was not accepting his mistake I gave up but decided to take this further. The staff at the counter at that time apologized & accepted that it is their mistake & shouldn't do that. He offered me a complimentary pastry & discount on my next birthday cake order which I refused. That staff really insisted to me take complimentary pastry which then I did but at the same time I even bought several other confectionery & savory items. (Cannot post the entire birthday cake picture as it has my nephew's name written on it).
